name: cz-transfer-pricing
description: Use this skill for Czech transfer pricing (převodní ceny) in tax year 2026. It covers the arm's length rule and the definition of related persons (spojené osoby, the 25% capital or voting test and other links) in Income Taxes Act § 23(7), the self-adjustment in § 23(3)(a)(17), the related-party transactions annex to the corporate return (Přehled transakcí se spojenými osobami, 25 5404/E) and who must file it (CZK 40 million assets, CZK 80 million turnover or 50 employees, plus a foreign related party, a tax loss or an investment incentive), documentation under Tax Code § 92 and Financial Administration guidance D-334 and GFŘ D-34, binding rulings on prices (APAs, § 38nc and § 38nd, guidance GFŘ D-32), country-by-country reporting (EUR 750 million), penalties and late payment interest. Trigger on: transfer pricing Czech Republic, převodní ceny, spojené osoby, cena obvyklá, závazné posouzení ceny, Local File Czech. Out of scope: corporate tax in general (cz-corporate-income-tax), withhol
